text:
alex: Heads up — prod embeddings are spiking 5xx on long inputs since 09:05UTC. I have a candidate hotfix image rev-2026.03.21-hotfix that fixes a padding bug. Requesting expedited deploy. Can we pin and skip canary for 30m window?
eng-deploy-bot: deploy request received: service=embeddings image=rev-2026.03.21-hotfix initiator=alex. Default canary=true. To override: `--canary=false` (admins only).
maria: what's the risk if we skip canary? last time we saw a mem growth pattern on a small fraction of traffic.
sam: if it's a padding bug the risk is limited, but it touched the tokenizer path — non-zero chance of perf regression. Recommend pin to 5% canary for 10m, then full if metrics look good.
oncall-ops: oncall here — production errors at ~7% of embedding requests. If we pin-only (no canary) we might worsen. Need a rollback plan and who will execute.
jess: infra lead — I can greenlight skip-canary if we deploy with emergency circuit-breaker (auto-rollback on error-rate > 3% over 5m) and reserve capacity in eu-west1. I can add the rollout flag: `--circuit-breaker=5m:3%` and `--reserve=2x`
alex: thanks jess. We still need two approvers to bypass normal canary policy. Sam + ricky pls ack.
ricky: product — we need embeddings in prod for search relevance (severe). ack to fast-track. :thumbsup:
sam: ack, but force the circuit-breaker and telemetry hooks. Also please attach the smoke test set: `smoke/embeddings-longprompts.json` to the deploy job.
eng-deploy-bot: Deploy job queued. Command: ```
deploy create --service=embeddings --image=rev-2026.03.21-hotfix --canary=false --circuit-breaker=5m:3% --reserve=2x --smoke-test=smoke/embeddings-longprompts.json
```
eng-deploy-bot: Canary disabled by override flag. Executing preflight smoke tests...
eng-deploy-bot: Preflight smoke tests passed (all 12 cases). Starting rollout to prod pool eu-west1.
maria: monitoring logs and tailing errors. hitting same stack trace on one pod initially, but then pod restarted and errors dropped. continuing watch.
alex: keep rollback command ready: `deploy rollback --service=embeddings --to=rev-2026.03.19-stable`
oncall-ops: standing by to execute rollback if circuit-breaker fires. Also notify support and set the status page if >10% customer impact.
jess: telemetry hooks in place, KV cache warmed, reserved capacity allocated. If we hit any perf regressions we can cut traffic back to dedicated pool and re-route via eu fallback.
eng-deploy-bot: Rollout reached 100% after 6m. Live metrics: error-rate fell from 7% -> 0.4%, p95 latency stable. Circuit-breaker not triggered.
alex: awesome — thanks everyone. ricky can you do a quick note in release notes and escalate to CS?
ricky: will add brief to release notes and ping CS.
maria: leaving monitoring for next 30m. will call rollback if anything spikes.
sam: sanity check: please run a quick eval vs our regression tests to ensure embedding drift <= 0.02 for key prompts.
jess: kicked off eval job.
eng-deploy-bot: Eval job completed: embedding-drift max=0.008, within threshold.
alex: closing fast-track. Documenting: pinned image rev-2026.03.21-hotfix -> prod, skipped canary with circuit-breaker and reserve capacity. Rollback command staged. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
